correctness.rationale: For a cyclic configuration with c occupied runs the exact count is N/c*C(K-1,c-1)*C(N-K-1,c-1), Gibbs weight q^(K-c); q~lambda*N^2 yields tight Bessel run-count limit. Uniform positive compositions give E[A|c]=c(K-c)/(K-1), E[B|c]=c(c-1)/(N-K-1), and kth falling factorial moments O(N^-k); this implies E j->alpha*rho, j->0 in probability, Var(j)/N->alpha^2 lambda rho, higher scaled moments and rare-event threshold. Independently recomputed finite weighted balance equations and small-N run counts. The infinite statement follows analytic dominated convergence not finite checks.
